claims: "Golden" from the movie KPop Demon Hunters won Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
"Golden" was performed by HUNTR/X (Ejae, Audrey Nuna, and Rei Ami).
"Golden" became the first K-Pop song to win the Oscar.
"Golden" was written by Ejae, Mark Sonnenblick, Joong Gyu Kwak, Yu Han Lee, Hee Dong Nam, Jeong Hoon Seo, and Teddy Park.
"Dear Me" – Diane Warren: Relentless: Performed by Kesha (Diane Warren) was a 2026 Best Original Song nominee.
"I Lied to You" – Sinners: Performed by Miles Caton (Raphael Saadiq & Ludwig Goransson) was a 2026 Best Original Song nominee.
"Sweet Dreams of Joy" – Viva Verdi!: Performed by Ana María Martinez (Nicholas Pike) was a 2026 Best Original Song nominee.
"Train Dreams" – Train Dreams: Performed by Nick Cave and Bryce Dessner was a 2026 Best Original Song nominee.
The song "Golden" was performed live at the ceremony with a high-energy, illuminated stage performance.
The creators of "Golden", representing a mix of Korean and American songwriting talent, dedicated their win to resilience in the industry.
